name: cold14-st2
title: h4a with PR627's two factored jp8 cold ends stacked, at dispatch jp8 x71, ck x1 with an exact per-time-Hall owner map (exact-window MIP with RINS, warm-started from PR627's map)
summary: Provider menu {ck, jp8}: h4a words; the jp8 cold_end recipe stacks PR627's factored ends 590 and 581 (premix re-derived in h4a's basis by solve627.py; q92 += 1/4 S403 at anchor 1665 found by fix581.py; recipe built by stack.py with the reviewed build_cold_end.apply). Owner search with Stack492's solve_h.py (helper ranges from the word R; objective sum F(r) = r*(73/r)^b, b = 0.001635) on the st2 provider locals (ColdThird runs/D4): (1) aggregate free-dispatch LP over {ck, jp8} (crossover, tight 3) warm-started from PR627's map -> LP-PATTERNS-AGG.json, which selects jp8 at every time; (2) dispatch: the LP argmax with ck pinned at time 5 (stage 2), because the global controls' partner() needs two dispatched providers -> DISPATCH.json (jp8 x71, ck x1); (3) exact-window LP (crossover) at that dispatch over base + AGG patterns with weight >= 0.01 -> LP-PATTERNS-EX.json, bound 523257.7591528998; (4) exact-window MIP, RINS around the EX vertex (slack 2/1), gap 1e-9, 2 threads, 240 s, warm-started from PR627's map; it exited normally within the time limit, but its status/gap line was not recorded (child stdout lost); (5) mkplan.py --locals (st2 locals) reproduces data/PLAN.json byte for byte. The map is admitted by the package's verifier chain, not by the search.

dispatch.origin: at the dispatch jp8 ×71, ck ×1 (the aggregate free-dispatch LP selects jp8 at every time; ck is pinned at time 5 because the global controls need two dispatched providers)
dispatch.plan_rule: the window MIP's PLAN with the provider registry re-derived from the admitted provider locals (widths over the word's R helpers) and `profile`/`assignment_sha256` recomputed from the map (Stack492 mkplan.py)

owners.origin: an exact per-time-Hall exact-window MIP solution (RINS around the exact-window LP vertex, 240 s, warm-started from PR627's map; solver status/gap not recorded)
owners.warm_owners_origin: PR627's `data/OWNERS.json.gz` (complex-571-cold14-k492b, jeremydiviney), the warm start of the aggregate LP and the MIP

search.tool: solve_h.py (Stack492's copy: helper ranges from the word R)
search.dispatch_rule: per-time argmax of LP-PATTERNS-AGG selections (jp8 everywhere), then ck pinned at time 5

lp_inputs.LP-PATTERNS-AGG.json: aggregate free-dispatch LP relaxation over the st2 words {ck, jp8} (crossover, tight 3), warm-started from PR627's map
lp_inputs.DISPATCH.json: the dispatch {time: provider}: jp8 everywhere except ck at time 5
lp_inputs.LP-PATTERNS-EX.json: exact-window LP relaxation (crossover) at that dispatch over the base patterns plus aggregate-LP patterns with weight >= 0.01
lp_inputs.TEMPLATE-PLAN.json: the PLAN whose windows/order/registry template the nominator reuses (same as PR622's)

result.status: not recorded (exit 0 within the 240 s limit; nomination PASS_EXACT_LITERAL_OWNER_NOMINATION)

commands.rins: rec2.py S2b locs2 S2b-disp.json S2-agg/LP-PATTERNS.json w627 240 -> solve_h.py --template-plan TEMPLATE-PLAN.json --b 0.001635 --threads 2 --provider ck=<locs2>/ck-local --provider jp8=<locs2>/jp8-local --dispatch DISPATCH.json --pattern-file LP-PATTERNS-AGG.json --pmin 0.01 --warm-owners WARM-OWNERS.json.gz --warm-plan WARM-PLAN.json --exact-windows --seconds 240 --gap 1e-9 --rins LP-PATTERNS-EX.json --rins-slack 2 --rins-fslack 1
